subject.title: fix(agents): guard CLI loopback prompt tools

question: Should maintainers refresh this narrower branch, land the broader sibling, or replace both with one combined prompt-tool hardening branch?
rationale: Both drafts are maintainer-owned, protected, overlapping, and at least this one is currently conflicting, so automation should not pick the permanent landing branch on its own.

options.title: Land one refreshed combined branch
options.body: Refresh or replace one branch with both the loopback sanitizer and direct CLI name guard, rerun focused CLI runner tests plus the changed gate, and close the unused draft after landing.

options.title: Refresh this narrower branch only
options.body: Land only the loopback schema-projection sanitizer here and leave direct CLI prompt-tool name hardening to a separate follow-up.

options.title: Pause until branch selection
options.body: Keep both overlapping drafts open until the owner decides which one should become the merge candidate.

recommendation.title: Land one refreshed combined branch
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace one branch with both the loopback sanitizer and direct CLI name guard, rerun focused CLI runner tests plus the changed gate, and close the unused draft after landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns both overlapping maintainer drafts and is assigned to this PR.
